descriptionChirho: The basic intransitive Qal sense of שָׁכַר: to become drunk, be in a state of intoxication from wine or strong drink, used across all Qal inflections including imperfect, imperative, perfect, consecutive, and infinitive construct.
The factitive-causative sense of שָׁכַר in both Piel and Hifil stems: to make someone drunk or cause them to become intoxicated, with God or a human agent as subject acting upon others.
The reflexive Hitpael sense of שָׁכַר: to make oneself drunk or behave in a drunken manner, emphasizing the subject's own agency in becoming intoxicated.
The adjectival use of שָׁכַר describing a state of being drunk, functioning as a predicate or attributive adjective rather than a finite verb.
